summary: In Ansible 10.7.0 the planned removal of netapp.storagegrid was cancelled. The collection stays in Ansible 11 and is now maintained by another NetApp team.
questions: Is netapp.storagegrid still being removed from Ansible?
Who maintains the netapp.storagegrid collection now?

answer_card.title: netapp.storagegrid removal cancelled
answer_card.answer_md: The removal of `netapp.storagegrid` was cancelled. It will not be removed from Ansible 11, and another NetApp team has taken over maintenance.
